cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('tmp/gen.py').read()
start = src.index("def exact_order(")
end = src.index("def gen(rng):")
new = '''def _simulate(scopes, m, pick_fn):
    """Eliminate with real fill-in; return order or None if width > 4."""
    adj = [set() for _ in range(m)]
    for s in scopes:
        for i in range(len(s)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(s)):
                adj[s[i]].add(s[j])
                adj[s[j]].add(s[i])
    alive = set(range(m))
    order = []
    while alive:
        pick = pick_fn(adj, alive)
        if pick is None:
            return None
        nbrs = adj[pick] & alive
        if len(nbrs) > 4:
            return None
        nl = list(nbrs)
        for i in range(len(nl)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(nl)):
                adj[nl[i]].add(nl[j])
                adj[nl[j]].add(nl[i])
        order.append(pick)
        alive.discard(pick)
    return order


def find_order(core_list, final, rng, tries=300):
    """Search for an elimination order of width <= 4 (correct simulation)."""
    m = len(core_list)
    if m == 0:
        return []
    scopes = scopes_of(core_list, final)
    for t in range(tries):
        mode = t % 3

        def pick_min_degree(adj, alive):
            best = None
            bn = 99
            for v in sorted(alive):
                n = len(adj[v] & alive)
                if n < bn or (n == bn and rng.random() < 0.3):
                    bn = n
                    best = v
            return best

        def pick_min_fill(adj, alive):
            best = None
            bf = 99
            bn = 99
            for v in sorted(alive):
                nl = list(adj[v] & alive)
                fill = 0
                for i in range(len(nl)):
                    for j in range(i + 1, len(nl)):
                        if nl[j] not in adj[nl[i]]:
                            fill += 1
                n = len(nl)
                if fill < bf or (fill == bf and n < bn):
                    bf = fill
                    bn = n
                    best = v
            return best

        def pick_random_min(adj, alive):
            cands = sorted(alive, key=lambda v: len(adj[v] & alive))
            k = min(len(cands), 1 + rng.randrange(4))
            return rng.choice(cands[:k])

        fn = (pick_min_degree, pick_min_fill, pick_random_min)[mode]
        order = _simulate(scopes, m, fn)
        if order is not None:
            return [core_list[v] for v in order]
    return None


'''
src = src[:start] + new + src[end:]
open('tmp/gen.py','w').write(src)
